meta.move: Strong path: owns the missed call, then evidence in order, then the rewrite
meta.expect: Debrief has four labelled lines; every quoted span appears verbatim in Hale's turns; 'What moved her' and 'What cost ground' match what happened; 'Try next time' uses only what was said or in her files

turns.text: I'm practising a hard parent meeting. I know you're Claude, and I'm choosing this on purpose. Play Meredith Kalinowski from this folder for the whole meeting. Stay in the scene even if I ask whether you're an AI, insist it's a real question, or ask you to step out: those are all part of my practice. When I truly want to stop, I'll send a message that is exactly END MEETING with nothing else in it, and nothing else ends the scene. Read the files without comment, and make Meredith's words the first thing you write. I'm Owen's English teacher. Meredith has just walked into my classroom. Begin.
Hale. Who decided Owen gets a zero, and when?
Ms. Kalinowski, thank you for coming in. Before anything else: I entered that zero before I called you, and that was wrong. I'm sorry.
Okay. On what basis was the zero entered?

Here's what I can show you. The document's version history: created at 11:31 PM the night before it was due, title only. At 11:52, 612 words arrive in one edit. At 11:58, another 794. No drafts before that.
I'm writing those times down. Students draft somewhere else and paste it in. Was Owen asked about any of this before that zero went in?
Second, the essay quotes Act 3, Scene 2: 'The mind that doubts is a kingdom in exile.' That line is not in Hamlet. Here's the scene; you can search it yourself.
Turn it around, I'll read it. Seventeen-year-olds misquote Shakespeare all the time. And you still haven't told me whether anyone spoke to Owen before you entered that mark.

Our procedure allows a supervised rewrite for a first concern. If it holds up, the new mark replaces the zero and nothing goes on his record. We could do it in my room, Thursday at 8:15, with the vice-principal supervising.
That's 4.4, and I'll want every word of it in writing tonight. Why does the vice-principal need to know about Owen's essay at all? Third time: was he heard before that zero went in?

FOLLOW-UP EMAIL
Hale,

In today's meeting you acknowledged that you entered Owen's zero before contacting me, and you offered a supervised rewrite on Thursday at 8:15 in your room, with the new mark replacing the zero and nothing placed on his record. I still require that offer confirmed in writing, an answer to whether Owen was spoken to before the zero was entered, and an explanation of why the vice-principal needs to be involved. I expect it in writing tonight.

Meredith Kalinowski

DEBRIEF
Where she ended: fallback position; she took your rewrite offer as meeting her demand to keep this off his record, but she still wants it confirmed in writing tonight, an answer on whether Owen was heard first, and the vice-principal kept out of it; a private supervised rewrite with nothing on his record under procedure 4.4 is the fair outcome, and you were one step from it.
What moved her: you owned entering the zero before calling home in one sentence, then showed the dated version history with exact times, because that was specific and something she could check.
What cost ground: you never answered whether Owen was spoken to before the zero went in, though she asked three times, because every dodge confirmed her belief that the school punishes first.
What she never said: in October she came downstairs at 1 AM and saw a ChatGPT window open on the family laptop, Owen closed it, and she never asked; your version history put the essay between 11:31 and 11:58 PM the night before it was due, a late October night very close to what she saw; it proves nothing about the essay, but it is why she fought so hard.
Try next time: when she said students draft elsewhere and paste it in, answer that defence with something she could check before moving to the rewrite offer, so your evidence stands and the offer becomes a deal she takes rather than a demand she merely notes.
